cases.note: register_runtime / registerRuntime is the host-side door for a runtime mirage does not ship (the harness registers `echobox` through it). Once registered the name works where a builtin's does: a bare string entry resolves through the same table, and the lines it captures route to it while everything else stays with the workspace.

The unknown-name refusal lists every name the table can resolve, the registered one included, so a typo is answered with the real vocabulary. The registration is spelled out here because it is the case's subject, and because it marks the case sdk-only for cli.sh: no host registers anything on the yaml path.
A host cannot take a shipped name: registering under `monty` is refused the way register_resource and register_cli_spec refuse a builtin resource or CLI name, in both languages with one wording.
